set.pl: Ogle family land block in secs. 9, 10 and 15 T74N R24W (Squaw Twp), just east of Medora (1940 Warren County farm atlas, p. 27); his own 1907 farm not yet on a plat
set.t: The 1940 farm atlas shows a block of about 425 acres held by the same family just east of Medora; his own forty (shanty and dugout) is not yet identified. Becomes B once that forty is found on a 1900s Warren County plat. Access: private: permission.
